caveats: An owner's goal is an allocated goal: the segment's goal shared by annual quota and the days employed in the year, from the roster as known at the plan date. Someone hired after that date has no original allocation. It is a planning allocation, never a measure of a person's performance, and what a person is shown to have produced is the record of their deals. Ownership, quota and roster segment have no history in the files: a deal's owner, a person's annual quota and the segment they sit in are today's values standing in for the plan date. Only employment dates and deal data are cut at the plan date, so a later hire, departure or deal cannot move a goal, but an edit to quota or roster segment would.

reasons.no_goal: There is no goal here, or it is zero, so there is nothing to compare with.
reasons.not_allocated: No goal was allocated here: this person was not a quota-carrying member of this segment on the plan-start roster (for example, hired after the plan date).
reasons.not_compared_at_owner: A rate or an average at one person's level rests on a thin slice of a pooled model, so it is shown as recorded and not compared with a goal.
reasons.not_modeled: This period has not begun, so this figure is not modeled for it.
reasons.too_few: Too few observations stand behind this ratio for a stable comparison.
reasons.vacuous: For a period that has begun the forecast is the recorded fact, which is also the basis the goal was frozen from, so the comparison carries no information.
